fixtures.preview: 12th-placed United host bottom-of-the-table Spurs, with both sides desperate for a result.
talking_points: United are 12th with 5 points from 5 games, and Michael Carrick is reportedly under pressure.
Spurs are bottom and winless in five; Roberto De Zerbi has made 13 starting-XI changes, the most in the league.
United are without Sesko, Dorgu, Mazraoui, Ugarte and de Ligt; Amad is in contention, Mainoo and Rashford are being assessed, and new signing Carlos Baleba should be fit to debut.
United have won only one of the last nine meetings (3 draws, 5 defeats), though they won 2-0 here last season.
